title: LINIJE 2 I 9 PONOVO VOZE UOBIČAJENOM TRASOM

sections.text: Obaveštavamo sve korisnike javnog prevoza da se linija 2 na relaciji Srpski šor-Novo naselje, kao i linija 9 na relaciji Srpski šor-Nova opština-ATB sever, počev od 21.08.2026., vraćaju na svoju uobičajenu trasu ulicom Proleterskih brigada.

text_translations.en: We inform all public transport users that line 2 on the route Srpski šor-Novo naselje, as well as line 9 on the route Srpski šor-Nova opština-ATB sever, starting on 08/21/2026, will return to their usual route along Proleterskih Brigada Street.

sections.text: Izmena na pomenutim trasama od 22.06.2026. više neće biti na snazi.

text_translations.en: Changes on the mentioned routes from June 22, 2026. will no longer be in effect.

title_translations.en: LINES 2 AND 9 ARE RUNNING AGAIN ON THE USUAL ROUTE

sections.text: Poštovani putnici,

sections.text: Obaveštavamo vas da će od 31.07.2026. godine pa do daljnjeg, zbog izvođenja radova na izgradnji kružnog toka na Majšanskom putu, kod raskrsnice sa Ulicom Jovana Mikića, doći do privremene izmene trase autobuskih linija 3 i 13.

text_translations.en: We inform you that from 31.07.2026. until further notice, due to the construction of the roundabout on Majšanski put, near the intersection with Jovana Mikić Street, there will be a temporary change in the route of bus lines 3 and 13.

text_translations.en: Buses on lines 3 and 13 near the Patria Hotel continue straight along Szegedinski Street, Jovana Mikić Street, instead of turning left into Đure Đaković Street.

title_translations.en: CHANGE OF ROUTE ON LINES 3 and 13

sections.text: Poštovani korisnici,

text_translations.en: Dear users,

sections.text: Obaveštavamo vas da će zbog lošeg stanja mosta preko reke Krivaje u Đurđinu, isti biti zatvoren za saobraćaj počev od 19.12.2025. godine, do daljnjeg, radi izvođenja radova na rekonstrukciji.

text_translations.en: We inform you that due to the poor condition of the bridge over the Krivaja River in Đurđin, it will be closed to traffic starting from 12/19/2025. year, until further notice, for the purpose of performing reconstruction works.

sections.text: Usled navedenog, linija 30 Subotica – Đurđin – Subotica neće saobraćati preko pomenutog mosta, u skladu sa uslovima koje odrede nadležni organi.

text_translations.en: Due to the above, line 30 Subotica - Đurđin - Subotica will not operate over the mentioned bridge, in accordance with the conditions set by the competent authorities.

sections.text: Linija 30 biće skraćena do stajališta „Lazine“. Zbog navedenih radova, stajališta „Uprava“ i „Mala stanica“ privremeno neće biti u upotrebi.

text_translations.en: Line 30 will be shortened to the "Lazine" stop. Due to the aforementioned works, the stops "Administration" and "Small station" will temporarily not be in use.

sections.text: To znači da polasci iz Subotice na liniji 30 neće saobraćati do krajnjeg odredišta, već do stajališta „Lazine“, dok će polasci iz Đurđina saobraćati od stajališta „Lazine“, sa prolaznim vremenom pomerenim za dva (2) minuta kasnije u odnosu na vremena polaska predviđena važećim redom vožnje sa stajališta „Mala stanica“.

text_translations.en: This means that departures from Subotica on line 30 will not travel to the final destination, but to the "Lazine" stop, while departures from Đurđin will travel from the "Lazine" stop, with the transit time shifted by two (2) minutes later compared to the departure times provided by the valid timetable from the "Mala stanica" stop.

sections.text: O svim daljim izmenama u organizaciji saobraćaja, kao i o eventualnim dodatnim prilagođavanjima, korisnici će biti blagovremeno obavešteni. Molimo putnike za razumevanje i strpljenje tokom trajanja radova. U Subotici, dana 18.12.2025. godine

text_translations.en: Users will be informed in a timely manner about any further changes in the organization of traffic, as well as about possible additional adjustments. We ask passengers for their understanding and patience during the works. In Subotica, on 18.12.2025. year

sections.text: Srdačan pozdrav,

text_translations.en: Best regards,

title: Za čistiji vazduh, za čistiju budućnost

sections.text: Sa ponosom želimo da Vam predstavimo prvi CNG autobus u Subotici, prozvođača Otokar. Prigradsko vozilo sa 55 mesta za sedenje i 22 mesta za stajanje, sa pogonom na komprimovan prirodni gas (CNG). Ovaj autobus predstavlja važan korak ka zelenijem i održivijem javnom prevozu u našem gradu.

text_translations.en: We are proud to present the first CNG bus in Subotica, manufactured by Otokar. Suburban vehicle with 55 seats and 22 standing seats, powered by compressed natural gas (CNG). This bus represents an important step towards greener and more sustainable public transport in our city.

sections.text: Privredno društvo Trans-jug prepoznaje značaj u oblasti zaštite životne sredine, i kontinuirano ulaže u vozila koja zadovoljavaju najviše ekološke standarde.

text_translations.en: The Trans-jug company recognizes the importance of environmental protection, and continuously invests in vehicles that meet the highest environmental standards.

sections.text: Naša misija je jasna- pružiti kvalitetan prevoz, uz smanjenje emisija štetnih gasova i očuvanje životne sredine za buduće genracije.

text_translations.en: Our mission is clear - to provide quality transportation, while reducing harmful gas emissions and preserving the environment for future generations.

title_translations.en: For cleaner air, for a cleaner future

title: SUBUS kartica- vaš pametan izbor za jednostavno i povoljno putovanje!

sections.text: Pozivamo sve korisnike javnog prevoza da pribave SUBUS karticu – praktično rešenje koje omogućava brzo, efikasno i jeftinije korišćenje kako gradskog, tako i prigradskog saobraćaja!

text_translations.en: We invite all users of public transport to get a SUBUS card - a practical solution that enables fast, efficient and cheaper use of both city and suburban transport!

sections.text: SUBUS kartica dolazi u dve varijante, u zavisnosti od vaših potreba:

text_translations.en: The SUBUS card comes in two variants, depending on your needs:

sections.text: Personalizovana mesečna kartica, koja glasi na ime korisnika

text_translations.en: Personalized monthly card, bearing the user's name

sections.text: Elektronski novčanik, koji ne glasi na ime i funkcioniše po principu pre-paid sistema

text_translations.en: An electronic wallet, which does not read in the name and functions according to the principle of a pre-paid system

sections.text: Mesečne karte

text_translations.en: Monthly tickets

sections.text: Gradska mesečna karta omogućava neograničen broj putovanja na svim gradskim linijama, kao i na gradskim relacijama na prigradskim linijama, tokom celog meseca.

text_translations.en: The city monthly ticket allows an unlimited number of trips on all city lines, as well as on city routes on suburban lines, throughout the month.

sections.text: Prigradska mesečna karta vam omogućava da svakodnevno putujete iz vašeg mesta stanovanja do Subotice (i nazad), ali i da BESPLATNO koristite sve gradske linije – bez dodatnog plaćanja!

text_translations.en: The suburban monthly ticket allows you to travel daily from your place of residence to Subotica (and back), but also to use all city lines for FREE - without additional payment!

sections.text: Elektronski novčanik

text_translations.en: Electronic wallet

sections.text: Za one koji ne putuju svakodnevno – elektronski novčanik je idealno rešenje! Uplatite iznos koji želite i koristite prevoz u skladu sa sopstvenim potrebama. Posebna pogodnost: u gradskom saobraćaju karta košta samo 90 dinara ako koristite SUBUS karticu!

text_translations.en: For those who do not travel every day - an electronic wallet is the ideal solution! Pay the amount you want and use the transport according to your own needs. Special benefit: in city traffic, the ticket costs only 90 dinars if you use the SUBUS card!

sections.text: Gde možete nabaviti SUBUS karticu? Vrlo jednostavno – posetite autobusku stanicu i odaberite vrstu kartice koja najviše odgovara vašim potrebama.

text_translations.en: Where can you get a SUBUS card? Very simple - visit the bus station and choose the type of card that best suits your needs.

sections.text: Za više informacija, kontaktirajte nas !

text_translations.en: For more information, contact us!

sections.text: SUBUS – vaša karta za jednostavniji svakodnevni prevoz!”

text_translations.en: SUBUS – your ticket for simpler everyday transportation!”

title_translations.en: SUBUS card - your smart choice for a simple and affordable trip!

sections.text: Dragi posetioci,

text_translations.en: Dear visitors,

sections.text: Dobrodošli na našu web stranicu posvećenu autobuskom prevozu putnika !

text_translations.en: Welcome to our website dedicated to bus passenger transport!

sections.text: Sa velikim zadovoljstvom Vas pozdravljamo, i zahvaljujemo što posećujete našu platformu.

text_translations.en: We welcome you with great pleasure, and thank you for visiting our platform.

sections.text: Naša misija je da Vam pružimo sve potrebne informacije i usluge vezane za autobuski prevoz, kako bismo Vaše putovanje učinili prijatnijim i lakšim.

text_translations.en: Our mission is to provide you with all the necessary information and services related to bus transportation, in order to make your trip more pleasant and easier.

sections.text: Na našoj stranici možete pronaći detalje o linijama koje obavljamo kao prevoznik, redovima vožnje, servisnim informacijama, kao i o ostalim uslugama koje pruža naše preduzeće.

text_translations.en: On our page you can find details about the lines we operate as a carrier, timetables, service information, as well as other services provided by our company.

sections.text: Pišite nam, uvek smo tu za sva Vaša pitanja.

text_translations.en: Write to us, we are always here for all your questions.

sections.text: Hvala Vam što ste deo naše zajednice, i što nam ukazujete poverenje.

text_translations.en: Thank you for being part of our community, and for trusting us.

sections.text: S poštovanjem,

text_translations.en: Sincerely,

title: KONKURS ZA VOZAČE I BUDUĆE VOZAČE AUTOBUSA – VIŠE IZVRŠILACA PJ SUTRANS - SUBOTICA

sections.text: Trans-jug d.o.o. PJ Sutrans Subotica je dugogodišnje i priznato preduzeće u oblasti javnog prevoza putnika koje pruža kvalitetnu i pouzdanu uslugu na teritoriji Subotice i okolnih mesta. Naša misija je obezbediti bezbedan i efikasan prevoz kroz profesionalni rad i stalno unapređenje kadrova. Ponosni smo na tim vozača koji svojim angažovanjem doprinosi našem uspehu i zadovoljstvu putnika.

text_translations.en: Trans-jug d.o.o. PJ Sutrans Subotica is a long-standing and recognized company in the field of public passenger transportation that provides quality and reliable service on the territory of Subotica and surrounding towns. Our mission is to provide safe and efficient transportation through professional work and continuous improvement of personnel. We are proud of the team of drivers who contribute to our success and passenger satisfaction with their engagement.

sections.text: U cilju daljeg razvoja i proširenja tima, raspisujemo konkurs za:

text_translations.en: In order to further develop and expand the team, we are announcing a competition for:

sections.text: 1. Profesionalne vozače autobusa sa vozačkom dozvolom D kategorije

text_translations.en: 1. Professional bus drivers with category D driver's license

sections.text: Ovim pozivom tražimo iskusne i motivisane vozače za rad u gradskom i prigradskom linijskom saobraćaju, kao i u vanlinijskom prevozu putnika. Kandidati treba da poseduju:

text_translations.en: With this invitation, we are looking for experienced and motivated drivers to work in urban and suburban scheduled traffic, as well as in offline passenger transportation. Candidates should possess:

sections.text: Ličnu kartu

text_translations.en: Identity card

sections.text: Vozačku dozvolu D kategorije

text_translations.en: Category D driver's license

sections.text: Kvalifikacionu karticu vozača (CPC)

text_translations.en: Driver Qualification Card (CPC)

sections.text: Tahografsku karticu vozača

text_translations.en: Tachograph card of the driver

sections.text: Važeće lekarsko uverenje

text_translations.en: A valid medical certificate

sections.text: Izvod o nekažnjavanju i kaznene evidencije (MUP)

text_translations.en: Certificate of non-criminal record and criminal record (MUP)

sections.text: Naše preduzeće nudi: rad u dinamičnom poslovnom okruženju, mogućnost usavršavanja i profesionalnog napredovanja.

text_translations.en: Our company offers: work in a dynamic business environment, the possibility of training and professional advancement.

sections.text: 2. Buduće vozače autobusa – kandidate bez vozačke dozvole D kategorije i CPC kartice

text_translations.en: 2. Future bus drivers - candidates without a category D driver's license and CPC card

sections.text: Trans-jug d.o.o. želi da pruži priliku svima koji žele da započnu karijeru u oblasti prevoza putnika, ali još nisu stekli neophodne dozvole i kartice. U saradnji sa auto školom Grand d.o.o. iz Bačke Topole, kandidati koji se prijave preko ovog oglasa dobijaju povoljne uslove i mogućnost zaposlenja odmah nakon završene obuke i polaganja za CPC u Agenciji za bezbednost saobraćaja.

text_translations.en: Trans-jug d.o.o. wants to give an opportunity to everyone who wants to start a career in the field of passenger transport, but has not yet acquired the necessary licenses and cards. In cooperation with the driving school Grand d.o.o. from Bačka Topola, candidates who apply through this advertisement receive favorable conditions and the possibility of employment immediately after completing the training and passing the CPC at the Traffic Safety Agency.
